outcome: Sensory processing patterns in infants/toddlers, as measured by the Infant/Toddler Sensory Profile
finding: Significant differences in sensory processing patterns were observed based on age, sex, and gestational age at birth, but not mode of birth.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in sensory processing between children born by cesarean and those born through natural childbirth from birth to 6 months and 7-36 months.
